description: "I'm Abdennour, a computer engineering student skilled in Python, C++, offline AI, Arduino, and design. For the "martian map" challenge, we're building an offline survival system linking NASA data with physical hardware. I'm seeking: a Data Analyst (NASA terrain), a 3D Developer (immersive simulations), and a Pitch Expert. Join me to blend hardware, AI, and design into a winning prototype!"
summary:
MARS GENESIS LAB is more than just a place to read facts about the Red Planet. It’s an interactive science lab that lets you explore Mars, experiment with different conditions, and see how they could have shaped the planet.

Rather than simply reading about the possibility of life on Mars, you get to investigate it yourself. You can change the atmosphere, temperature, water levels, and mineral composition to see how these factors might have influenced the formation of organic molecules and early protocells. You can also explore how life on Mars could be different from life on Earth.

But the experience doesn't end with ancient Mars. Another module takes you into the future, where you can explore how the human body might react, adapt, and survive in the harsh conditions of Mars today.

Every experiment is shaped by the variables you choose, so changing the conditions can lead to completely different results. The project uses real NASA datasets and planetary maps as its foundation, while clearly separating established scientific knowledge from hypothetical scenarios.
